Macrons

Consonantal i

SearchHow we decideRulings

Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

potential noun

promise: abilities that may grow

also great potential, show promise, promising

classical

Cic. Sen. 26: adulēscentibus bonā indole praeditīs
Liv. 21.2.4: ob altam indolem (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 156: personality, indolēs

indolēs, indolis f.

noun, third declension

natural gifts, promise, character

What is inborn in someone and may grow (Lewis & Short: native quality, natural abilities).

Other words

  • spēs, speī f. — promise, hope (of a young person)

    noun, fifth declension · classical · Matius in Cic. Fam. 11.28.6: optimae speī adulēscentī; Cic. Cael. 80: adulēscentiam plēnam speī maximae

    In the genitive of quality: a young man of great promise is optimae speī adulēscēns.

  • ingenium, ingeniī n. — talent, natural ability

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Quint. 1.3.1: ingeniī signum in parvīs praecipuum memoria est; Traupman 32: talent, ingenium

Examples

  • ut enim adulēscentibus bonā indole praeditīs sapientēs senēs dēlectantur, … sīc adulēscentēs senum praeceptīs gaudent

    for as wise old men take delight in young men of good promise, … so the young enjoy the teaching of the oldCic. Sen. 26

See also clever, possible, ability.
